collective-collective:ashbyhq:fbc250e3-1.title: Member Success Manager
collective-collective:ashbyhq:fbc250e3-1.description: About Collective: Collective is on a mission to redefine the way businesses-of-one work. Our technology and team of trusted advisors help members achieve financial independence by taking care of everything from business incorporation to accounting, bookkeeping, tax services, and access to a thriving community, all in one integrated platform. We believe in empowering self-employed people to enjoy the same tax savings that big companies get, so they can focus on their passion, not paperwork. Featured in Forbes, Business Insider, Yahoo, Bloomberg, Financial Times, TechCrunch, and more. We are backed by General Catalyst, Sound Ventures (Ashton Kutcher and Guy Oseary), QED Investors, Google’s Gradient Ventures, Expa, and other investors who have financed iconic companies like YouTube, Substack, Twitch, Box, Hims, Instacart, and Lyft. About the role: As a Member Success Manager at Collective, you are the business owner of your book. Roughly 400 solo entrepreneurs rely on you as their trusted advisor and main point of contact. You're the client-facing representation of our team and our brand. We're looking for people who truly care about helping solopreneurs build the businesses they're betting their livelihoods on. This is a proactive role, not a reactive one. You won't just be responding to tickets. You'll be working your book like a portfolio. Knowing who's at risk before they ask, spotting the members ready for the next step, and showing up early instead of late. The members you serve deserve someone in their corner before something goes wrong, and you'll be measured on whether you deliver that. You'll be exposed to a wide variety of scenarios that require resourcefulness and judgment. No two days will be the same, but the work is genuinely rewarding. You are a key advisor to our entrepreneurs, and the difference you make in their year, financially and operationally, is real. Please note: You are expected to be online and available for members 9am-5pm Pacific Time hours. What you'll do: Manage and Grow Your Book of Business - Manage a portfolio of approximately 400 members as their dedicated success manager. - Build strong relationships and proactively engage members based on their goals, risks, and opportunities. - Provide year-round support and guidance tailored to each member’s financial and business needs. - Identify at-risk members and expansion opportunities, driving retention and growth within your book. Advise Members on Tax and Business Operations - Educate members on S Corporations, tax strategy, reasonable salary decisions, and how Collective works end-to-end. - Guide members through quarterly check-ins, estimated taxes, and ongoing business operations. - Support members with questions related to tax, accounting, payroll, and business management. Deliver Exceptional Member Experience - Respond to member inquiries within established service-level expectations. - Actively manage and resolve member requests, escalating when appropriate. - Conduct proactive member calls and check-ins to provide strategic guidance and support. - Follow up on member feedback and surface actionable insights to internal teams. Stay Organized and Collaborate Cross-Functionally - Maintain accurate documentation across Salesforce and internal systems. - Complete assigned tasks and workflows in a timely manner. - Partner cross-functionally to advocate for members and improve the overall experience. - Build trust through clear, professional communication across email, phone, and video. What you'll bring: - 2+ years of tax, accounting, or related client-facing experience. - Strong understanding of S Corporations, small business tax strategy, and ongoing client relationship management. - Familiarity with bookkeeping, payroll, CRM, and workflow tools such as Xero, QBO, Gusto, Salesforce, Slack, and Google Workspace. - Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing a large book of business in a fast-paced environment. - Strong written and verbal

distro-distro:lever:eacfbc22-10c7-422c-a.title: Quality Assurance Technician
distro-distro:lever:eacfbc22-10c7-422c-a.description: Quality Assurance Technician The Quality Assurance Technician plays a crucial role in ensuring that products meet safety, quality, and regulatory standards. Essential Functions • Conducting Inspections: QA technician performs routine inspections of raw materials, ingredients, and finished products to ensure they meet the required specifications. • Testing Samples: They collect and test product samples for quality control purposes, checking factors like taste, texture, appearance, and nutritional content. • Monitoring Processes: QA Tech monitor food production processes to ensure compliance with food safety standards (e.g., temperature, cleanliness, and hygiene practices). • Documentation: Maintain accurate records of inspections, tests, and production processes, ensuring all data is up-to-date and compliant with regulations. • Corrective Actions: If any issues are identified, they work with production teams to implement corrective actions and improve processes to prevent future problems. • Internal Audits: QA Tech may conduct internal audits to assess adherence to company standards, ISO certifications, and regulatory requirements. • Training Staff: They may assist in training production staff on best practices for food safety and quality standards. • Reporting Issues: QA Tech identify any non-compliance or issues and report them to supervisors or management, helping to ensure the production of safe and high-quality food products. • Equipment Calibration: Ensuring that equipment used in testing and production is calibrated correctly and functioning within specifications. • Safety and Cleanliness: Maintain a clean and safe working area. Following all safety protocols, including proper lifting techniques and using appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE). Ensuring compliance with company policies and OSHA regulations Qualifications (Education/Experience) • Experience Requirements: o 3+ Years of Experience in quality assurance, food safety, or production in the food industry. o Experience in performing inspections, conducting tests, and understanding food safety regulations (e.g., HACCP, GMPs) is highly valued. • Specific Skills or Certifications (preferred not required): o HACCP Certification (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points) o Experience in BRC certified plant. o Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) knowledge. • Additional Experience: o Familiarity with laboratory testing equipment or quality control instruments is a plus. o Experience in data documentation and reporting (using Microsoft Office or specialized software) is important. Key Skills: • Attention to Detail: Essential for identifying inconsistencies or deviations in product quality. • Communication Skills: For reporting issues and working with production teams. • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to identify root causes of quality issues and recommend corrective actions. • Knowledge of Food Safety Regulations: Understanding of food safety laws and standards, like FDA, USDA, and FSMA. Physical Requirements The physical demands described within the Essential Functions section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform this job. Other duties or tasks may be assigned as required. Management may modify, change, or add to the duties of this description at any time without notice. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to: • Communicate with others both verbally and in writing. • Be independently mobile. • Use a computer and keyboard. • Regularly sit, stand, walk, reach, stretch, stoop, bend, for extended periods. • Ability to lift/carry 25 to 60 lbs. • Exposure to noise levels that require hearing protection. #HireFinder #LI-Onsite

flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: COMPANY DESCRIPTION Founded through Flagship Pioneering’s venture creation engine, Terrana Biosciences is a cutting-edge agricultural biotechnology company developing innovative RNA-based products to address global agricultural challenges. We are committed to advancing sustainable farming solutions through precision technologies that ensure environmental safety and regulatory compliance. THE ROLE Terrana Biosciences is building a new generation of RNA-based technologies to transform agriculture. We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented contract Laboratory Operations Associate to join our team in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina. In this role, you will ensure our laboratories operate safely, efficiently, and in compliance with regulatory requirements. You’ll support scientists by managing laboratory operations and striving for continuous improvement and operational efficiency. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Partner with scientists and cross-functional teams to anticipate operational needs and minimize disruptions to research. Manage daily laboratory operations, including purchasing support, shipping and receiving, inventory, vendor and service contracts, equipment maintenance, documentation, and record keeping. Champion a strong culture of laboratory safety. Coordinate biological and chemical waste disposal in compliance with regulations. Support USDA permitting and other regulatory compliance activities. Respond to occasional after-hours laboratory emergencies and assist the Controlled Environment Agriculture team with plant care when needed. PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Chemistry, Biotechnology, or a related scientific discipline with 5+ years of relevant experience. Co-op and internship experience may be considered. Ability to work onsite, full-time in Research Triangle Park, NC. Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving, and multitasking skills. Commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement. Additional Qualifications: Experience supporting laboratory operations in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or life science organizations. Experience with plant care or greenhouse operations. Experience with LIMS and laboratory or project management software preferred. Knowledge of laboratory safety regulations, hazardous materials handling, and regulatory compliance. Familiarity with IATA/DOT shipping, BSL-1/BSL-2 operations, OSHA, EPA/RCRA, USDA APHIS requirements, or project leadership is a plus. A proactive, service-oriented approach. The ability to anticipate needs, solve problems, and adapt in a fast-paced environment. Strong collaboration skills and a desire to support a mission-driven scientific team. LOCATION: Durham, NC ABOUT FLAGSHIP PIONEERING: Flagship Pioneering invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health, sustainability and beyond. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated more than 100 companies. Many of these companies have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at www.flagshippioneering.com . At Flagship, we accept impossible missions to enable bigger leaps. Our core values guide us through uncertainty and toward lasting impact. We are an equal opportunity employer . The role combines professional voice performance with linguistic evaluation, annotation, and AI-focused quality assessment.
